meta.title: Households (Demo)
meta.description: A WordPress app for running a household, or several. A home is a place with its own address: its people, the facts the house needs you to know, the things kept there and what needs doing. People who log in get an account; people who do not — a toddler, a relative you only keep notes about — still get a record, and what travels with them reads the same in every home they belong to. Pre-loaded with three homes — two separated parents and a grandparent — and three children who belong to all of them, rotating week on and week off between the parents with a one-off day at the grandparent's. The youngest has no account at all. Member accounts use the password "demo".
meta.author: Alex Kirk

steps.code:
<?php
use Households\Access;
use Households\Storage;
use Households\Whereabouts;

require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

if ( ! taxonomy_exists( 'household' ) || ! class_exists( '\\Households\\Storage' ) ) {
	return;
}

$admin = get_user_by( 'login', 'admin' );
$admin_id = $admin ? (int) $admin->ID : 1;
$admin_email = $admin ? $admin->user_email : 'admin@example.com';
$storage = new Storage();

// Three homes: two separated parents and a grandparent.
$home_a = $storage->create_home( "Sam's Home", $admin_id );
$home_b = $storage->create_home( "Jo's Home", $admin_id );
$home_c = $storage->create_home( "Nana's House", $admin_id );
if ( ! $home_a || ! $home_b || ! $home_c ) {
	return;
}

// Sam is whoever is logged in, so the demo opens on a home you belong to.
$sam = $storage->add_person( $home_a, 'Sam', [
	'email'     => $admin_email,
	'birthdate' => gmdate( 'Y-m-d', strtotime( '-38 years +200 days' ) ),
] );
$jo = $storage->add_person( $home_b, 'Jo', [
	'email'     => 'jo@example.com',
	'password'  => 'demo',
	'birthdate' => gmdate( 'Y-m-d', strtotime( '-40 years +45 days' ) ),
] );
$nana = $storage->add_person( $home_c, 'Nana', [
	'email'    => 'nana@example.com',
	'password' => 'demo',
	'label'    => 'Grandparent',
] );

$mia = $storage->add_person( $home_a, 'Mia', [
	'email'     => 'mia@example.com',
	'password'  => 'demo',
	'is_child'  => true,
	'birthdate' => gmdate( 'Y-m-d', strtotime( '-9 years +12 days' ) ),
] );
$ben = $storage->add_person( $home_a, 'Ben', [
	'email'     => 'ben@example.com',
	'password'  => 'demo',
	'is_child'  => true,
	'birthdate' => gmdate( 'Y-m-d', strtotime( '-6 years +80 days' ) ),
] );
// Pip has no account. Nobody logs in as a two-year-old, but her shoe size is
// still worth writing down, and both houses need to read the same answer.
$pip = $storage->add_person( $home_a, 'Pip', [
	'is_child'  => true,
	'birthdate' => gmdate( 'Y-m-d', strtotime( '-2 years +150 days' ) ),
] );

// The children belong to all three homes; Sam can reach all three so the demo
// has something to show in the views that span homes. Sam rotates between
// none of them, so the app says so rather than claiming Sam is in three
// places at once — belonging to a home is not the same as being at it.
foreach ( [ $mia, $ben, $pip ] as $child ) {
	Access::join( $child, $home_b );
	Access::join( $child, $home_c );
}
foreach ( [ $home_b, $home_c ] as $home ) {
	Access::join( $sam, $home );
}
foreach ( [ $home_a, $home_b, $home_c ] as $home ) {
	Access::set_admin( $home, $admin_id, true );
}
Access::set_admin( $home_b, Access::user_for_person( $jo ), true );
Access::set_admin( $home_c, Access::user_for_person( $nana ), true );

$storage->add_task( $home_a, 'Pack school bag', $mia, 'task', gmdate( 'Y-m-d' ) );
$storage->add_task( $home_a, 'Feed the cat', $ben, 'task', gmdate( 'Y-m-d' ) );
$storage->add_task( $home_a, 'Tidy room', $mia, 'task', gmdate( 'Y-m-d', strtotime( '+1 day' ) ) );
$storage->add_task( $home_a, 'Dentist appointment', $ben, 'appointment', gmdate( 'Y-m-d', strtotime( '+2 days' ) ) );
$storage->add_task( $home_a, 'Parent-teacher meeting', $sam, 'appointment', gmdate( 'Y-m-d', strtotime( '+4 days' ) ) );
$storage->add_task( $home_a, 'Book summer camp', 0, 'task', gmdate( 'Y-m-d', strtotime( '+10 days' ) ) );

$storage->add_task( $home_b, 'Water the plants', $ben, 'task', gmdate( 'Y-m-d' ) );
$storage->add_task( $home_b, 'Practice piano', $mia, 'task', gmdate( 'Y-m-d', strtotime( '+1 day' ) ) );
$storage->add_task( $home_b, 'Swimming lesson', $mia, 'appointment', gmdate( 'Y-m-d', strtotime( '+3 days' ) ) );
$storage->add_task( $home_b, 'Renew passports', $jo, 'task', gmdate( 'Y-m-d', strtotime( '+14 days' ) ) );

// What travels with a person is prose, and dated, so its age shows.
$storage->save_person( $mia, [ 'about' => "Shoe size 33 — March 2026\nClothes 134 — March 2026\n\nAllergic to peanuts and house dust.\nSwimming on Wednesdays, needs the blue bag." ] );
$storage->save_person( $ben, [ 'about' => "Shoe size 29 — February 2026\nClothes 116 — February 2026\n\nInhaler is in the kitchen drawer, both houses." ] );
$storage->save_person( $pip, [ 'about' => "Shoe size 22 — April 2026\nClothes 92 — April 2026\n\nStill in nappies at night. Sleeps with the grey rabbit — it lives at whichever house she is at." ] );

// The things people ask about a house they are not in every day.
$storage->add_note( $home_a, Storage::FACT, 'Wifi', 'Network "sams-wifi", password on the fridge door' );
$storage->add_note( $home_a, Storage::FACT, 'Water main valve', 'Under the stairs, behind the coats' );
$storage->add_note( $home_a, Storage::FACT, 'Bin day', 'Paper on Tuesday, everything else on Friday' );
$storage->add_note( $home_b, Storage::FACT, 'Wifi', 'Network "jos-flat", password taped under the router' );
$storage->add_note( $home_b, Storage::FACT, 'Spare key', 'With the neighbour in flat 3' );
$storage->add_note( $home_c, Storage::FACT, 'Wifi', 'Network "nana", ask Nana' );
$storage->add_note( $home_c, Storage::FACT, 'Doctor', 'Practice on the square, closed Wednesday afternoons' );

$storage->add_note( $home_a, Storage::ITEM, 'Grey rabbit', 'Travels with Pip. If it is missing, it is at the other house.' );
$storage->add_note( $home_a, Storage::ITEM, 'Booster seat', 'Hall cupboard, top shelf' );
$storage->add_note( $home_b, Storage::ITEM, 'Swimming kit', 'Blue bag by the door on Wednesdays' );
$storage->add_note( $home_c, Storage::ITEM, 'Travel cot', 'Attic, with the spare bedding' );

// The children rotate week on, week off between the two parents' homes. Nana's
// is in the rotation as a third home, used for a single day the pattern knows
// nothing about.
$monday = gmdate( 'Y-m-d', strtotime( 'monday this week' ) );
foreach ( [ $mia, $ben, $pip ] as $child ) {
	Whereabouts::save_rotation( $child, [
		'pattern'         => Whereabouts::PATTERN_WEEK,
		'start_date'      => $monday,
		'homes'           => [ $home_a, $home_b, $home_c ],
		'changeover_time' => '17:00',
	] );
	Whereabouts::set_override( $child, gmdate( 'Y-m-d', strtotime( $monday . ' +9 days' ) ), $home_c );
}
